description: This file defines the 'FastRouteDispatcher' class, which extends the GroupCountBased dispatcher from the FastRoute library. It handles routing dispatch logic for the Slim framework, including route matching, fallback mechanisms for HEAD requests and fallback routes, and retrieving allowed methods for a URI.

classes.name: FastRouteDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher for routing that extends the FastRoute GroupCountBased dispatcher, providing methods to dispatch routes and retrieve allowed HTTP methods.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a request based on HTTP method and URI, returns routing results or fallback to GET or wildcard routes, or indicates method not allowed or not found.

methods.name: routingResults
methods.description: Private method that performs the core route matching logic for a given HTTP method and URI, returning matched route info or not found.

methods.name: getAllowedMethods
methods.description: Returns an array of allowed HTTP methods for a given URI by examining static and variable route maps.
